svg.title: ccRCC agentic multi-omics GraphRAG architecture
svg.desc: Four aligned input branches for CPTAC omics, spatial Visium and single-cell data, PubMed literature, and external knowledge flow through deterministic evidence layers, a SQLite and NetworkX knowledge graph, four MCP servers, four Claude Code agents, and a self-contained Jinja2 HTML report. All labels are in English and all graphics are crisp vector shapes.
svg.text: Combines omics, spatial, literature and external evidence
Every subject–predicate–object claim links to a traceable Evidence record
Deterministic scoring: convergence v3 · target / biomarker profiles · 1,000 weight draws
Evidence checks: gene-linked IDs · numbers · direction · freshness
LLM: interpretation only · Code: numbers, tables, figures and citations
